name: Dorankus
title: Warehouse Keeper

warehouse/30139.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Dorankus: We guard your property with our lives -- you have my word! Why not deposit your valuables with us and sleep easier tonight?

warehouse/30139-1.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Dorankus: What do you want to do?

links.text: Deposit item in a Private Warehouse.
Withdraw item from a Private Warehouse.

warehouse/30139-2.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Dorankus: What do you want to do?

links.text: Deposit item in a Clan Warehouse.
Withdraw item from a Clan Warehouse.

Q00166_MassOfDarkness/30135-01.html.text: Trader Iria: Abyssal Celebrant Undrias has sent you, I see. Here is the special dagger crafted by Karrod for use in this year's Ceremony of Darkness. Beautiful, isn't it? Ah, be careful! It may be ceremonial, but its blade is still razor-sharp!

Q00166_MassOfDarkness/30139-01.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Dorankus: Ah! You're here for the item Undrias entrusted to me last year? Here it is! Dreviant Wine, made from the poison of spiders. A rare vintage that even I have never tasted... Be sure to tell Undrias how faithfully I fulfilled my service to him!

Q00166_MassOfDarkness/30143-01.html.text: Master Trudy: Undrias sent you? Very well; take this scripture to him. It was discovered in an abandoned mine in the Misty Mountains during a battle with those vile Orcs. Surprising, isn't it, to see something written by ancient Humans who also served Gran Kain? Undrias plans to recite a portion of…

Q00166_MassOfDarkness/30135-02.html.text: Trader Iria: Take this Ceremonial Dagger to Abyssal Celebrant Undrias. It is needed for the Ceremony of Darkness, so guard it with your life. If something were to happen to it, I shudder to think of what Undrias would do to you...

Q00166_MassOfDarkness/30139-02.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Dorankus: You haven't left for the Temple of Shilen yet? Hurry and deliver the Dreviant Wine I gave you to Abyssal Celebrant Undrias! It is very precious, so take care not to break the bottle!

Q00166_MassOfDarkness/30143-02.html.text: Master Trudy: Why haven't you delivered Garmiel's Scripture to Abyssal Celebrant Undrias? Hurry, you fool! If the ceremony is delayed on your account, Undrias will flay the flesh from your bones!
